data.name: Jayeshbhai
data.gender_notes: Jayeshbhai is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jayeshbhai is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jaya', which means victory. The name signifies success and triumph in life. The name Jayeshbhai carries the meaning “Victory, Success” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Jayeshbhai usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jayeshbhai is a spiritual name that signifies the triumph of the soul over the material world.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayeshbhai total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
